description: This file defines the CppWrapperCpu class responsible for generating C++ wrapper code for CPU execution in PyTorch's AOT (Ahead-Of-Time) compilation framework. It contains methods for generating kernel calls, handling constants, managing imports, and constructing the main entry points for the generated C++ code, integrating with the PyTorch AOT inductor pipeline.
